direction.concept: Seasoned expedition guide through difficult information terrain.
direction.summary: Calm adult Australian English expedition guide: grounded, experienced, precise, evidence-first, quietly confident.

accent.rendering: Natural and regionally Australian, the way an experienced local sounds on a field recording. Never performed as a gimmick.

providerBindings.note: Provider-specific settings live in config/narration-providers.json, never in a VideoSpec, and never a voice id here: a provider interprets the direction above with its own controls. The publication binding names its provider and the versioned binding it approves, and pins the content address of that binding as resolved (src/narration/publication.ts: provider, model, voice, this identity, its language, the variant settings, the chunk policy). A binding that does not hash to the pin is refused before any synthesis; moving the pin is a reviewed change. Credentials are read from the environment at synthesis time only and are never written to manifests.
